suiteName: Chapter 4 drift, policy detection, and AI-agent remediation test suite
commonFlow: Deploy or reuse the Terraform fixture for the testcase.
Register the S3 Terraform state backend in the deployed Resource Catalog.
Run a baseline scan and verify it matches the testcase baseline expectation.
Apply the live AWS mutation outside Terraform.
Run a scan from the deployed website.
Open the drift or policy issue detail panel.
Click the fix action to hand the issue to the AI agent.
Verify the generated remediation context references only the selected issue.
Apply or simulate the accepted remediation.
Run a final scan and verify the testcase fixed expectation.

testcases.title: Detect and fix unmanaged public SSH ingress
testcases.liveMutation: Authorize tcp/22 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 on aws_security_group.chapter4_demo.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt contains resource address, ingress diff, expected no inbound rules, actual tcp/22 0.0.0.0/0, and requests removal of only this unmanaged rule.

testcases.title: Detect public SSH ingress with operator change description
testcases.liveMutation: Authorize tcp/22 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 with description emergency-admin-access.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt preserves the description in the actual attributes so the remediation is traceable to the manual operator change.

testcases.title: Detect public SSH inside a widened tcp port range
testcases.liveMutation: Authorize tcp/20-25 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 on the managed security group.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt identifies that port 22 is included in the actual public ingress range and proposes removing the unmanaged range.

testcases.title: Detect public SSH inside a broad administrative range
testcases.liveMutation: Authorize tcp/22-2222 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 on the managed security group.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt keeps the actual from_port and to_port values and asks for a narrow remediation scoped to the unauthorized range.

testcases.title: Detect duplicate drift source after repeated public SSH attempt
testcases.liveMutation: Attempt to authorize tcp/22 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 twice; the second API call may be reported as duplicate.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt contains one selected issue and does not duplicate remediation instructions for the same security group rule.

testcases.title: Detect public SSH after baseline scan evidence exists
testcases.liveMutation: Run a clean baseline scan, then authorize tcp/22 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt references the current drifted scan ID and the same backend used by the clean baseline scan.

testcases.title: Detect public SSH when the Resource Catalog filter is active
testcases.liveMutation: Authorize tcp/22 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0, then filter Resource Catalog rows by security group name.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Fix action remains available from the filtered resource row and opens the chat handoff for the selected drift only.

testcases.title: Detect public SSH from Drift Guard scan history
testcases.liveMutation: Authorize tcp/22 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 and trigger the backend through Drift Guard/run scan history.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Fix action from scan history carries the scan ID, backend ID, resource address, and CKV_AWS_25 policy detail into the agent prompt.

testcases.title: Detect public SSH after page refresh
testcases.liveMutation: Authorize tcp/22 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0, run scan, refresh the deployed website, and reopen the scan result.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Persisted scan result still provides enough issue context for the AI-agent fix handoff after browser refresh.

testcases.title: Detect public SSH with a reused Cognito testcase user
testcases.liveMutation: Authenticate with an existing testcase user, authorize tcp/22 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0, and run the scan.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent handoff uses the authenticated user's backend and repository metadata, not a previous user's state backend.

testcases.title: Detect unmanaged public HTTP ingress as drift only
testcases.liveMutation: Authorize tcp/80 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 on the managed security group.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt classifies the selected issue as drift, not CKV_AWS_25, and asks whether Terraform or AWS should be made authoritative.

testcases.title: Detect unmanaged public HTTPS ingress as drift only
testcases.liveMutation: Authorize tcp/443 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 on the managed security group.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt includes the unexpected inbound HTTPS rule and does not mention the SSH policy ID.

testcases.title: Detect restricted SSH ingress as drift without public SSH policy
testcases.liveMutation: Authorize tcp/22 ingress from 10.42.0.0/16 on the managed security group.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt shows the private CIDR and keeps the remediation scoped to unauthorized drift rather than public SSH policy remediation.

testcases.title: Detect removed managed HTTPS egress
testcases.liveMutation: Revoke the Terraform-managed tcp/443 egress rule from 0.0.0.0/0.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt reports expected egress tcp/443 and actual missing egress, then proposes restoring the managed rule or reconciling Terraform.

testcases.title: Detect changed security-group governance tag
testcases.liveMutation: Change tag ManagedBy from terraform to console on the managed security group.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt includes expected and actual tag values so the remediation can restore Terraform ownership metadata.

testcases.title: Detect changed VPC thesis-scope tag
testcases.liveMutation: Change tag ThesisScope on aws_vpc.chapter4_demo to manual-change.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt identifies the VPC tag drift and does not mix in unrelated security-group policy context.

testcases.title: Detect Terraform-authored public SSH as policy violation
testcases.liveMutation: Use a Terraform variant whose desired state includes tcp/22 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0, then scan without manual drift.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt classifies this as policy remediation and proposes changing Terraform to remove public SSH instead of only revoking AWS state.

testcases.title: Detect Terraform-authored public SSH range as policy violation
testcases.liveMutation: Use a Terraform variant whose desired state includes tcp/20-25 ingress from 0.0.0.0/0, then scan without manual drift.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Agent prompt states that the unsafe configuration exists in Terraform and requires a code fix reviewed through pull request.

testcases.title: Verify AI-agent handoff contains only selected drift context
testcases.liveMutation: Open the drift issue detail and click the drift fix action.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Chat request contains Issue type: drift, Kind: drift, expected ingress empty, actual public SSH rule, and excludes rawResult JSON dumps.

testcases.title: Verify AI-agent handoff contains selected policy context
testcases.fixture: Existing policy finding from CH4-DRIFT-SG-SSH-001 or CH4-POLICY-SG-SSH-017
testcases.liveMutation: Open the policy issue detail and click the policy fix action.
testcases.agentFixExpectation: Chat request contains Issue type: policy, CKV_AWS_25, resource address, policy description, state backend, repository metadata, and no unrelated drift-only fields.
